concept: One continuous session inside oh-my-pi's own light editor. We keep cutting back to the same warm-paper app window and watch the IDE machinery do work no CLI agent shows: a rename cascades on its own, a real debugger attaches, and a kernel cell reaches back into the agent's own tools. The words name the mechanism the picture just enacted. It closes by crediting the builder.
money_shot_note: Scene 5, the loopback kernel cell. It is the one thing no other coding agent shows, so it is the peak and it gets the only stylized cut and the only foley button. The print-vs-debugger split runs earlier so the bright hash-anchor beat sits at the runtime midpoint.
transition_strategy: Hard cuts throughout (register cut). The single reserved dip transition fires only on the cut INTO the money shot. No swipe between scenes; the foley click-button lands on the money beat alone.
music_direction: Electronic, precise, mechanical, a build that lands its accent under the loopback cell. Not ambient wash.
